form.variant_mode_info: Turn on when this service has distinct tiers or packages that are priced separately (e.g. 30-min / 60-min / 90-min, Basic / Pro / Premium, by practitioner level). Price then lives on each variant rather than on this form.
form.unit_info: Free-text display unit for how this service is billed or counted (e.g. hr, session, visit, consult, cycle). Stocked consumables can use ea, pack, bottle.
form.product_kind_info: Whether this is the service you deliver, a supply you use to deliver it, or a good you resell.

product_kind_value_info.service: The offering itself — what the client pays for (consultation, treatment, session).
product_kind_value_info.stocked_good: Retail goods you hold inventory of and resell to clients (take-home products, merchandise).
product_kind_value_info.non_stocked_good: Items you sell but never stock — drop-shipped or ordered on demand.
product_kind_value_info.consumable: Back-of-house supplies used during service delivery and expensed on use (gauze, lotion, alcohol, gloves).

form.delivery_mode_info: How the client experiences or receives this item. Drives scheduling and billing behaviour.

delivery_mode_value_info.instant: Consumed or handed over on the spot — walk-in service, quick check.
delivery_mode_value_info.scheduled: Requires a booked appointment — the standard clinic/salon/professional service mode.
delivery_mode_value_info.shipped: Physically delivered to the client (mail-order, home-care kit).
delivery_mode_value_info.digital: Remote or online delivery (telehealth, recorded course, license).
delivery_mode_value_info.project: Multi-session engagement with milestones (treatment plan, case).

form.tracking_mode_info: How stock is counted. Only applies to physical goods and supplies.

tracking_mode_value_info.none: No tracking — for services and one-off orders.
tracking_mode_value_info.bulk: Count on hand — the normal choice for consumables and most retail goods.
tracking_mode_value_info.serialized: One row per unit — use for regulated items with lot/serial numbers (medical devices, controlled products).
